cases.title: Appointments can be booked on past dates with no error
cases.report: hi. my receptionist booked mrs aisha for 3 march 2025 by accident (we meant 2027) and the system just saved it?? no warning nothing. it should not let us book in the past right. we are sunrise clinic
cases.objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login and log in with email {{account1_email}} and password {{account1_password}}. Open the page for booking a new appointment. Select the patient named Aisha, set the date to 2025-03-03 and the time to 10:00, then click the button to book or save. Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'. Verify that the app shows an error saying the date is in the past and the appointment was not saved.

cases.title: Two patients can be booked into the same appointment slot
cases.report: we have 2 patients booked at 10:00 tomorrow?? how did the system allow that. sunrise clinic. the 2nd one should be blocked
cases.objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login and log in with email {{account1_email}} and password {{account1_password}}. Open the appointment booking page. Book an appointment for the first patient in the patient list on 2027-11-14 at 10:00 and submit. Open the appointment booking page again. Book an appointment for the second patient in the patient list on 2027-11-14 at 10:00 and submit. Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'. Verify that the second booking was refused with a message that the 10:00 slot on 2027-11-14 is already taken.
cases.rerecorded: Re-recorded with a fixed date (2027-11-14) instead of 'tomorrow' (old test: bug-20261113-124324-d930-4).
